title: Xcode DerivedData
explanation: Build products and indexes for every project ever opened in Xcode. Rebuilt on the next build.

title: Simulator devices (apps and data)
explanation: Apps and data installed in iOS simulators. Erasing resets every simulator to factory state.

title: iOS DeviceSupport
explanation: Debug symbols copied from physical devices. Recreated when a device is connected again.

title: Xcode Archives
explanation: Archived app builds. Needed to symbolicate crash reports of released versions.

title: Xcode caches
explanation: Xcode's own download and documentation caches. Recreated on demand.

title: Device logs
explanation: Crash and diagnostic logs pulled from connected devices. Keep them if you are still debugging a crash.

title: Simulator caches
explanation: Dyld and temporary caches for simulators. Regenerated when a simulator boots.

title: XCTest clone devices
explanation: Simulator clones made for parallel testing. Xcode creates them again for the next test run.

title: Xcode component downloads
explanation: Installer packages Xcode downloaded for components it has already installed.

title: SwiftUI previews
explanation: Simulator data used to render SwiftUI previews. Rebuilt when a preview is shown.

title: Unavailable simulators
explanation: Simulators for runtimes that are no longer installed. They cannot boot, so removing them loses nothing.
source: observed on macOS (xcrun simctl help delete)

title: Simulator runtimes
explanation: iOS/watchOS/visionOS runtimes (several GB each). Remove unused ones in Xcode > Settings > Components.

title: Xcode
explanation: The Xcode app itself (10+ GB). Remove it only if you no longer build for Apple platforms.

title: Swift Package Manager cache
explanation: Downloaded Swift packages and repositories. Fetched again on the next resolve.

title: CocoaPods cache
explanation: Downloaded pods. Fetched again by `pod install`.

title: CocoaPods spec repos
explanation: Local copy of the CocoaPods specs index. Modern CocoaPods uses the CDN and re-creates it if needed.

title: iPhone and iPad backups
explanation: Local device backups made by Finder. Delete old ones in Finder > device > Manage Backups.

title: Docker Desktop disk image
explanation: Virtual disk holding all images, containers and volumes. Shrink it with the prune commands, not by deleting it.

title: Docker build cache
explanation: Cached layers from `docker build`. Size comes from `docker system df`; builds get slower once.

title: Dangling Docker images
explanation: Untagged image layers left by rebuilds. No container or tag uses them.

title: Docker Desktop app caches
explanation: Logs and update caches of the Docker Desktop app, not your images or containers.

title: Docker CLI config and contexts
explanation: Registry credentials and contexts for the Docker CLI. Freeroom never touches them.

title: Docker Model Runner models
explanation: AI models pulled with `docker model pull`. Remove unused ones with `docker model rm`.

title: OrbStack data
explanation: Disk image with OrbStack's containers, images and Linux machines. Prune from Docker or remove machines in OrbStack.

title: Colima VMs
explanation: Colima's Linux VM disks with your images and containers. Use `colima delete` for profiles you no longer need.

title: Lima VMs
explanation: Disks of Lima Linux VMs. Remove unused ones with `limactl delete <name>`.

title: Rancher Desktop VM
explanation: VM disk of Rancher Desktop with images and Kubernetes state. Use Troubleshooting > Factory Reset to clear.

title: minikube
explanation: minikube clusters, VM images and cached Kubernetes binaries. `minikube delete --all --purge` removes everything.

title: Testcontainers settings
explanation: Small Testcontainers settings file. Nothing to reclaim.

title: npm cache
explanation: Downloaded npm packages. Fetched again on install.

title: npx cache
explanation: Packages downloaded to run `npx` commands. Downloaded again the next time you run them.

title: npm logs
explanation: Debug logs from npm runs.

title: pnpm store
explanation: Content-addressable package store. Pruning removes packages no project references.

title: Yarn cache
explanation: Downloaded Yarn packages.

title: Yarn Berry global cache
explanation: Global package cache of Yarn 2+. Fetched again on `yarn install`.

title: Bun install cache
explanation: Packages downloaded by `bun install`. Fetched again when needed.

title: Deno cache
explanation: Deno's global cache of remote modules and npm packages. Rebuilt on the next run.

title: node-gyp headers
explanation: Node.js headers downloaded to compile native modules. Downloaded again when needed.

title: TypeScript type cache
explanation: Type definitions the editor's TypeScript server downloaded automatically.

title: nvm Node.js versions
explanation: Installed Node.js versions. Remove unused ones with `nvm uninstall <version>`.

title: nvm download cache
explanation: Node.js archives nvm downloaded for versions that are already installed.

title: fnm Node.js versions
explanation: Node.js versions installed by fnm. Remove unused ones with `fnm uninstall <version>`.

title: Volta toolchains
explanation: Node, npm and global tools managed by Volta. Remove unused versions from Volta.

title: Playwright browsers
explanation: Browsers downloaded for end-to-end tests. Reinstall with `npx playwright install`.

title: Puppeteer browsers
explanation: Chrome builds downloaded by Puppeteer. Reinstalled with `npx puppeteer browsers install`.

title: Cypress binaries
explanation: Cypress app binaries for each version you installed. Reinstalled by `npx cypress install`.

title: Electron downloads
explanation: Electron runtimes and build tools downloaded when building Electron apps.

title: App updater caches
explanation: Downloaded installers of updates that were already applied.

title: Chrome headless shell
explanation: Headless Chrome builds downloaded by browser-testing tools. Downloaded again when a test needs them.

title: pip cache
explanation: Downloaded Python wheels.

title: uv cache
explanation: Packages and builds cached by uv. Fetched again on the next install.

title: uv-managed Python versions
explanation: Python interpreters installed by uv. Remove unused ones with `uv python uninstall <version>`.

title: uv tools
explanation: Command-line tools installed with `uv tool install`. Remove with `uv tool uninstall <name>`.

title: Poetry cache
explanation: Packages downloaded by Poetry. Fetched again on `poetry install`.

title: Poetry virtualenvs
explanation: Virtual environments Poetry created for your projects. Recreated by `poetry install`, but in-env changes are lost.

title: Conda package cache
explanation: Downloaded conda packages and tarballs. Environments keep working; installs re-download.

title: pyenv Python versions
explanation: Python versions built by pyenv. Remove unused ones with `pyenv uninstall <version>`.

title: Matplotlib font cache
explanation: Font list cache built by Matplotlib. Rebuilt on the next import.

title: IPython profile
explanation: IPython settings and command history. Small; kept.

title: Jupyter data
explanation: Jupyter kernels, extensions and runtime files. Usually small; review before removing kernels.

title: Ollama models
explanation: Local AI models. Remove the ones you don't use with `ollama rm <model>`.

title: Hugging Face cache
explanation: Models and datasets downloaded by Hugging Face libraries. Downloaded again when code needs them.

title: Hugging Face Xet cache
explanation: Chunk cache used to speed up Hugging Face downloads. Not needed to run models.

title: LM Studio models
explanation: Models you downloaded in LM Studio. Delete unused ones from LM Studio's My Models tab.

title: Whisper models
explanation: Speech-to-text models. Downloaded again when used.

title: PyTorch Hub cache
explanation: Model weights downloaded by PyTorch Hub and torchvision. Downloaded again when code loads them.

title: EasyOCR models
explanation: OCR models downloaded by EasyOCR. Downloaded again on next use.

title: Claude Code data
explanation: Claude Code settings, memory and session history. Prune old sessions from Claude Code, not by hand.

title: Claude Code CLI cache
explanation: Logs and cached data of the Claude Code CLI. Recreated as needed.

title: Claude cache
explanation: Web caches of the Claude app. Rebuilt automatically; quit the app first.

title: Go module cache
explanation: Downloaded Go modules. Fetched again by `go build`.

title: Go build cache
explanation: Compiled Go packages.

title: gopls cache
explanation: Index cache of the Go language server. Rebuilt when you open a Go project.

title: golangci-lint cache
explanation: Lint results cache. Rebuilt on the next run.

title: Go checksum database cache
explanation: Cached checksum database tiles. Fetched again when modules are verified.

title: goimports cache
explanation: Package index cache of goimports. Rebuilt automatically.

title: Cargo registry cache
explanation: Downloaded crates.

title: Cargo git dependencies
explanation: Git checkouts of crates used as git dependencies. Cloned again on the next build.

title: Rust toolchains
explanation: Installed Rust toolchains (about 1 GB each). Remove unused ones with `rustup toolchain uninstall <name>`.

title: Gradle caches
explanation: Downloaded dependencies and build cache.

title: Gradle wrapper distributions
explanation: Gradle versions downloaded by `./gradlew`. Downloaded again by the project that needs them.

title: Gradle daemon logs
explanation: Logs and registry of Gradle daemons. Stop daemons first with `./gradlew --stop`.

title: Gradle-provisioned JDKs
explanation: JDKs Gradle downloaded for toolchains. Downloaded again when a build requests them.

title: Maven repository
explanation: Downloaded Java dependencies.

title: Maven wrapper distributions
explanation: Maven versions downloaded by `./mvnw`. Downloaded again when needed.

title: SDKMAN candidates
explanation: JDKs and tools installed with SDKMAN. Remove unused versions with `sdk uninstall`.

title: SDKMAN archives
explanation: Downloaded archives of SDKs that are already installed (`sdk flush` cleans them too).

title: Installed JDKs
explanation: Java runtimes installed system-wide. Remove only versions no project uses.

title: Coursier cache
explanation: Scala/JVM artifacts downloaded by Coursier, sbt and Metals.

title: NuGet packages
explanation: Downloaded .NET packages. Restored on the next build.

title: .NET SDKs and runtimes
explanation: Installed .NET SDKs and runtimes. Remove old versions as Microsoft documents.

title: .NET global tools
explanation: Global .NET tools. Remove unused ones with `dotnet tool uninstall -g <name>`.

title: rbenv Ruby versions
explanation: Ruby versions built by rbenv. Remove unused ones with `rbenv uninstall <version>`.

title: RVM
explanation: Rubies and gemsets managed by RVM. Remove unused rubies with `rvm remove <version>`.

title: Dart/Flutter pub cache
explanation: Packages downloaded by `dart pub get` / `flutter pub get`. Fetched again on the next get.

title: Composer cache
explanation: PHP packages downloaded by Composer.

title: ccache
explanation: Compiler output cache for C/C++. Builds get slower until it refills.

title: vcpkg binary cache
explanation: Prebuilt C/C++ libraries cached by vcpkg.

title: Conan packages
explanation: C/C++ packages cached by Conan 2. Downloaded or built again on demand.

title: Haskell Stack root
explanation: GHC versions and package snapshots used by Stack. Large, but rebuilding takes long.

title: GHCup toolchains
explanation: GHC, cabal and HLS versions installed by GHCup. Remove unused ones with `ghcup rm`.

title: opam switches
explanation: OCaml compilers and packages per switch. Remove unused switches with `opam switch remove`.

title: Julia depot
explanation: Julia packages, artifacts and compiled caches. `Pkg.gc()` removes unused versions.

title: PlatformIO core
explanation: Embedded toolchains and platforms installed by PlatformIO. Re-downloaded per project when needed.

title: Arduino downloads
explanation: Installer archives of board packages that are already installed.

title: Arduino board packages
explanation: Toolchains for Arduino/ESP32 boards. Safe to remove if you no longer use Arduino.

title: Arduino IDE cache
explanation: Arduino IDE 2 caches and downloaded index files. Rebuilt on start.

title: Buf module cache
explanation: Protobuf modules downloaded by the Buf CLI.

title: Homebrew downloads
explanation: Old bottles and downloads. Installed formulae are not affected.

title: Homebrew logs
explanation: Build logs from formula installs.

title: Homebrew installed packages
explanation: Everything installed with Homebrew. Remove tools with `brew uninstall` and unused deps with `brew autoremove`.

title: JetBrains caches
explanation: IDE indexes. Rebuilt when a project is opened.

title: JetBrains logs
explanation: IDE log files.

title: JetBrains settings and plugins
explanation: IDE settings and installed plugins. Old version folders can be removed from the IDE, not by hand.

title: VS Code update leftovers
explanation: Installers of updates that were already applied.

title: VS Code caches
explanation: Web, compiled-code and extension download caches of VS Code. Rebuilt automatically; quit VS Code first.

title: VS Code logs
explanation: Diagnostic logs of VS Code.

title: VS Code workspace storage
explanation: Per-workspace state (open editors, extension data, local history). Grows for every folder opened.

title: VS Code extensions
explanation: Installed VS Code extensions. Uninstall unused ones from the Extensions view.

title: VS Code settings
explanation: Your VS Code settings and keybindings.

title: Cursor extensions
explanation: Installed Cursor extensions. Uninstall unused ones in Cursor.

title: Android SDK
explanation: Android platforms, build tools and system images. Remove unused packages in Android Studio's SDK Manager.

title: Android emulators (AVDs)
explanation: Virtual devices with their data (several GB each). Delete unused ones in Device Manager.

title: Android Studio logs
explanation: IDE logs of Android Studio.

title: Postman cache
explanation: Web caches, logs and update leftovers of Postman. Collections are synced to your account.

title: GitKraken caches
explanation: Web caches and update leftovers of GitKraken.

title: MongoDB Compass caches
explanation: Web caches and update leftovers of MongoDB Compass.

title: Lens caches
explanation: Web caches of the Lens Kubernetes IDE.

title: TablePlus cache
explanation: Cached data of TablePlus. Connections are not stored here.

title: Helm cache
explanation: Downloaded charts and repository indexes. Fetched again by `helm repo update`.

title: Kubernetes config
explanation: kubeconfig with cluster credentials. Freeroom never touches it.

title: Terraform plugin cache
explanation: Shared cache of Terraform providers (only if you enabled plugin_cache_dir). Re-downloaded by `terraform init`.

title: Terraform credentials
explanation: API tokens for Terraform Cloud. Never deleted.

title: TFLint cache
explanation: Rule plugins and caches of TFLint. Reinstalled by `tflint --init`.

title: Vagrant boxes
explanation: Base VM images for Vagrant. `vagrant box prune` removes old versions.

title: AWS credentials
explanation: AWS CLI credentials and config. Freeroom never touches them.

title: Azure CLI data
explanation: Azure CLI login tokens and config. Never deleted.

title: Google Cloud SDK config
explanation: gcloud credentials and configurations. Never deleted.

title: GitHub CLI config
explanation: GitHub CLI settings and auth. Never deleted.

title: SSH keys
explanation: Your SSH keys and known hosts. Never deleted.

title: GnuPG keyring
explanation: Your GPG keys. Never deleted.

title: Parallels virtual machines
explanation: Your Parallels VMs. Delete unused VMs from Parallels Control Center, which also removes snapshots.

title: UTM virtual machines
explanation: Your UTM VMs and their disks. Delete unused VMs from inside UTM.

title: VMware Fusion virtual machines
explanation: Your VMware Fusion VMs. Delete unused ones from Fusion's Virtual Machine Library.

title: VirtualBox virtual machines
explanation: Your VirtualBox VMs. Remove unused ones in VirtualBox with 'Delete all files'.

title: Browser caches
explanation: Web caches of Chrome, Arc, Firefox and Edge. Sessions, history and passwords are not stored here.

title: Chrome on-device AI model
explanation: Gemini Nano model used by Chrome's built-in AI. Chrome downloads it again if a feature needs it.

title: Chrome profile
explanation: Chrome bookmarks, history, passwords and extensions. Clear browsing data from Chrome instead.

title: Chrome for Testing profiles
explanation: Profiles created by automated browser tests. Recreated on the next test run.

title: Google Updater cache
explanation: Downloaded update packages for Chrome and other Google apps.

title: Safari cache
explanation: Web cache of Safari. History and bookmarks are stored elsewhere.

title: Safari data
explanation: Safari history, bookmarks and reading list. Clear history from Safari instead.

title: Firefox profiles
explanation: Firefox bookmarks, history, passwords and add-ons. Clear data from Firefox instead.

title: Arc data
explanation: Arc spaces, sidebar and profiles. Clear data from Arc instead.

title: Slack caches
explanation: Web caches of Slack. Messages stay in your workspace. Quit Slack first.

title: Microsoft Teams cache
explanation: Cache of the new Microsoft Teams. Chats stay on Microsoft's servers. Quit Teams first.

title: Zoom caches
explanation: Cached data and update files of Zoom.

title: Zoom recordings
explanation: Meetings you recorded locally. Move what you want to keep before deleting.

title: Discord cache
explanation: Web caches of the Discord app. Rebuilt automatically; quit the app first.

title: WhatsApp cache
explanation: Temporary cache of the WhatsApp app. Chats and media are stored elsewhere.

title: WhatsApp media
explanation: Photos, videos and files from your chats. Manage in WhatsApp > Settings > Storage.

title: Messages attachments
explanation: Photos and files from iMessage chats. Remove large ones in Messages or Settings > General > Storage.

title: Messages history
explanation: Your iMessage/SMS history database. Never deleted.

title: Mail mailboxes
explanation: Your local mail and mailboxes. Use Mail's own tools to remove messages.

title: Mail Downloads
explanation: Attachments you opened from Mail. The originals remain in the message.

title: FaceTime data
explanation: FaceTime settings and call data. Small; kept.

title: Microsoft Teams (classic) data
explanation: Leftover data of the retired classic Teams app. Not used by the new Teams.

title: TeamViewer caches
explanation: Cached data of TeamViewer.

title: Figma desktop cache
explanation: Figma desktop app data and cache. Files live in the cloud; clearing signs you out.

title: Spotify cache
explanation: Cached songs. Spotify downloads them again when needed.

title: Spotify offline storage
explanation: Songs you downloaded for offline listening plus Spotify's cache. Clear in Spotify > Settings > Storage.

title: Microsoft Office caches
explanation: Caches of Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook. Rebuilt on launch; documents are not stored here.

title: Office font cache
explanation: Font cache shared by Office apps. Rebuilt on the next launch.

title: Microsoft AutoUpdate cache
explanation: Downloaded Office update packages that were already installed.

title: Cloud storage folders
explanation: Files synced by OneDrive, Dropbox, Google Drive and Box. Free space with 'Remove Download' / 'Free up space'.

title: Adobe media cache
explanation: Conformed audio and preview files for Premiere Pro and After Effects. Rebuilt when projects are opened.

title: CapCut cache
explanation: Effects, templates and preview caches of CapCut. Projects are stored elsewhere.

title: Insta360 Studio caches
explanation: Preview and export caches of Insta360 Studio.

title: ExpressVPN cache
explanation: Cached data of ExpressVPN.

title: Crash reporter caches
explanation: Crash reports apps queued for upload.

title: Photos library
explanation: Your photos and videos. Turn on Optimize Mac Storage in Photos settings to keep originals only in iCloud.

title: Music library media
explanation: Songs, downloads and imported files in Music. Remove downloads from the Music app.

title: Music app cache
explanation: Artwork and streaming cache of the Music app.

title: TV app downloads
explanation: Movies and shows downloaded in the TV app. Remove downloads from the TV app.

title: TV app cache
explanation: Artwork and streaming cache of the TV app.

title: Podcasts downloads
explanation: Downloaded podcast episodes. Remove them in Podcasts > Settings, or turn on automatic removal.

title: Apple Loops and sound library
explanation: GarageBand/Logic sounds and loops. Manage in Logic > Sound Library rather than deleting files.

title: Logic Pro library
explanation: Logic Pro 12+ sound library bundle. Remove sound packs from Logic Pro > Sound Library.

title: Voice Memos
explanation: Your voice recordings. Delete them from the Voice Memos app.

title: Books
explanation: Downloaded books and audiobooks. Remove downloads from the Books app.

title: Notes
explanation: Your notes and their attachments. Never deleted.

title: iCloud Drive
explanation: Local copies of iCloud Drive files. Use Optimize Mac Storage or 'Remove Download' instead of deleting.

title: Trash
explanation: Files already moved to the Trash still use disk space until it is emptied.

title: Downloads
explanation: Review by hand: installers and archives here are often no longer needed.

title: Desktop
explanation: Screenshots and files on the Desktop. Review by hand.

title: Documents
explanation: Your documents. Freeroom never cleans this folder as a whole.

title: System temporary files
explanation: Managed by macOS and cleaned on restart. Do not delete by hand.

title: macOS system
explanation: The sealed, read-only macOS system volume. Cannot and must not be changed.

title: System Library
explanation: System-wide settings, drivers and app support. Only remove items an app's uninstaller lists.

title: Your Library folder
explanation: Settings and data of every app. Clean the specific items inside it, never the folder.

title: Application Support
explanation: Data of every app. Only specific known subfolders are safe to clean.

title: Preferences
explanation: App settings. Deleting them resets apps.

title: Keychains
explanation: Your passwords and certificates. Never deleted.

title: App containers
explanation: Sandboxed app data. Removing a container deletes that app's data.

title: Group containers
explanation: Data shared between apps of the same developer. Not a cache.

title: Swap and sleep image
explanation: Virtual memory swap files and the sleep image. macOS manages them; restart to shrink swap.

title: Spotlight index
explanation: Search index. Rebuild it from Spotlight settings if it seems too big.

title: System logs
explanation: Unified logs. macOS rotates and limits them automatically.

title: User logs
explanation: Crash and hang reports already sent or not needed. New ones are written as needed.

title: macOS update downloads
explanation: Software updates staged by macOS. Install or let macOS remove them.

title: System caches
explanation: System-wide caches managed by macOS and installers. Not safe to empty by hand.

title: Local Time Machine snapshots
explanation: Shown as purgeable space. macOS deletes them automatically when space is needed (`tmutil listlocalsnapshots /`).

title: Apple system assets
explanation: Downloaded system assets (voices, dictionaries, AI models). Managed by macOS.

title: Device sync settings
explanation: Folder that holds device backups and sync data. Manage backups from Finder.

title: Crash reporter data
explanation: Crash report metadata kept by macOS.

title: Apple app caches
explanation: Caches of App Store, Help, Maps and Safe Browsing. Rebuilt by macOS on demand.

title: User caches folder
explanation: Holds caches of every app. Clean the known items inside it, not the whole folder.

title: ~/.cache folder
explanation: Cache folder used by CLI tools. Clean the known items inside it, not the whole folder.

title: ~/.config folder
explanation: Settings of command-line tools. Not a cache.

title: ~/.local folder
explanation: Installed CLI tools and their data. Clean known items inside it, not the whole folder.

title: Shell history
explanation: Your command history. Small; kept.

title: Git config
explanation: Your Git settings.

title: Unused Docker images
explanation: Every image not used by a container, including ones you pulled on purpose. They can be pulled or rebuilt again.

title: Buildx builder cache
explanation: Build cache of buildx builders. Builds get slower once while the cache refills.

title: Stopped Docker containers
explanation: Containers that are not running. Their writable layer and any data not in a volume is lost when removed.

title: Unused Docker volumes
explanation: Volumes no container uses. They often hold databases; check before `docker volume prune`.

title: Claude Code versions
explanation: Native Claude Code builds; the current one is in use. Claude Code removes old versions itself.

title: Aerial wallpapers
explanation: Aerial wallpapers and screen savers macOS downloaded. Managed by macOS; pick a static wallpaper to stop downloads.

title: Xcode user settings
explanation: Xcode key bindings, code snippets, themes and breakpoints.

title: Command Line Tools
explanation: Compilers and git used by Homebrew and many tools. Keep unless full Xcode is installed and selected.

title: Simulator runtime caches
explanation: Shared caches built for installed simulator runtimes. Rebuilt by macOS; needs admin to remove.

title: Go-installed binaries
explanation: Tools installed with `go install`. Remove the ones you no longer use.

title: Cargo-installed binaries
explanation: Tools installed with `cargo install` plus rustup's proxies. Remove with `cargo uninstall <name>`.

title: Chrome component caches
explanation: Downloaded component installers and GPU shader caches of Chrome. Rebuilt automatically; quit Chrome first.

title: VS Code local history
explanation: Earlier versions of files you saved in VS Code (Timeline view). Removing it loses that undo history.

title: Tectonic TeX bundle cache
explanation: TeX support files downloaded by Tectonic. Downloaded again on the next build.

title: Zoom chat data
explanation: Zoom's local chat history and settings. Not a cache.

title: iCloud Drive state
explanation: iCloud Drive's sync database. Deleting it can break syncing.

title: Swift toolchains
explanation: Extra Swift toolchains from swift.org or swiftly. Remove versions you no longer build with.

title: Hugging Face datasets cache
explanation: Datasets downloaded and processed by the `datasets` library. Downloaded again when code loads them.
